title: Bollinger band
intent: Show an eight-observation trailing mean with a two-standard-deviation volatility band for one typed time series.

ai.create: Create a responsive UTC Bollinger chart from typed {id, date, value, series} rows using an eight-observation strict trailing window and bands two sample deviations from the mean.
ai.maintain: Change the window or deviation multiplier while preserving Plot's native compound mark semantics, explicit TanStack interval rows, stable keys, and cast-free channels.
